ruleDefinitions.name: New Process Created Via Taskmgr.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a process via the Windows task manager. This might be an attempt to bypass UAC

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\taskmgr\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\mmc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\resmon\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Taskmgr\\\.exe$")))
